title: Configuration Options
description: Master configuration and options patterns in ASP.NET Core.

data.text: The **Options pattern** provides a way to access configuration settings using strongly-typed classes.

data.title: Options Pattern
data.content: Bind configuration to a strongly-typed class

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Strongly-typed settings are easier to test
